# Auto-generated schematic symbols
import sys
import os

# Get project path and import kicad schematic interface
PROJECT_PATH = os.environ['PROJECT_PATH']
sys.path.append(PROJECT_PATH)
from modules.kicad_sch_interface import *

### Placing center symbol 1 : Connector:USB_B###

center_x_1, center_y_1 = 105.0, 148.0   # Center of an A4 sheet (210x297 mm)

add_schematic_symbol(symbol_lib="Connector", symbol_name="USB_B", pos_x=center_x_1, pos_y=center_y_1, reference="J1", value="USB_B", rotation=0, mirror="None")

### Placing other symbols in the Schematic with respect to the center symbol 1###

# Power symbols for VBUS and GND (optional, but useful for completeness)
add_schematic_symbol(symbol_lib="power", symbol_name="VBUS", pos_x=center_x_1 + (-30), pos_y=center_y_1 + (10), reference="#PWR_VBUS1", value="VBUS", rotation=0, mirror="None")
add_schematic_symbol(symbol_lib="power", symbol_name="GND", pos_x=center_x_1 + (-30), pos_y=center_y_1 + (-10), reference="#PWR_GND1", value="GND", rotation=0, mirror="None")

### Placing all global labels in the Schematic and connect them to the neighbor pin ###

# Add label D+ next to J1 pin D+
x_J1_Dp, y_J1_Dp = get_pin_location(symbol_ref="J1", pin_name="D+")
add_label(label_pos=[x_J1_Dp+(-10), y_J1_Dp+(0)], label_text="D+", label_ref="D+_0", label_type="input", text_orient="left")
# Connecting Label D+ label_id:0 to J1 pin D+ (Pin ID 1 -- Name D+)
connect_pins("D+_0", "1", "J1", "D+")

# Add label D- next to J1 pin D-
x_J1_Dm, y_J1_Dm = get_pin_location(symbol_ref="J1", pin_name="D-")
add_label(label_pos=[x_J1_Dm+(10), y_J1_Dm+(0)], label_text="D-", label_ref="D-_0", label_type="input", text_orient="right")
# Connecting Label D- label_id:0 to J1 pin D- (Pin ID 1 -- Name D-)
connect_pins("D-_0", "1", "J1", "D-")

### Connecting all wires in the Schematic ###

# Connect VBUS power symbol to J1 pin VBUS
connect_pins("#PWR_VBUS1", "VBUS", "J1", "VBUS")

# Connect GND power symbol to J1 pin GND
connect_pins("#PWR_GND1", "GND", "J1", "GND")

write_out_all_wires()
